chapters.title: Welcome to Workplace Safety Essentials
chapters.objective: Understand what this course covers and how it works at Acme.

blocks.say: Welcome to Workplace Safety Essentials. Over the next few chapters you'll learn by doing — dragging, clicking, and exploring, not just reading. Let's get started.
blocks.caption: Intro narration

blocks.prompt: Friendly flat-vector illustration of a diverse team at Acme starting an online training course, bright brand colors, clean modern style

blocks.text: Each chapter ends with a short quiz. Score 80% or higher to unlock the next chapter — you can retry as many times as you like.

speakers.name: Maya
speakers.avatarPrompt: friendly woman mentor portrait, flat vector avatar, warm smile

speakers.name: Sam
speakers.avatarPrompt: curious young man portrait, flat vector avatar, headphones

steps.speaker: Maya
steps.text: Hi! I'll guide you through this course.

steps.speaker: Sam
steps.text: Great — I learn best by doing.

steps.speaker: Maya
steps.text: Perfect, because that's exactly how this works. Click Continue when you're ready.

quiz.question: How do you unlock the next chapter?
options: Score at least 80% on the chapter quiz
quiz.explanation: Pass the quiz with 80%+ to continue; retries are unlimited.

quiz.question: What makes this course interactive?
quiz.explanation: You learn by doing across many interaction types.

chapters.title: Hazard awareness
chapters.objective: Apply hazard awareness confidently in your day-to-day work at Acme.

blocks.say: In this chapter we explore hazard awareness. Listen, then try the interactive exercises to lock it in.
blocks.caption: Hazard awareness narration

blocks.text: Hazard awareness is a core part of how Acme works. For new employees, getting this right early prevents mistakes and builds confidence.

blocks.prompt: Clean flat-vector concept illustration representing 'Hazard awareness' in a corporate training context, modern brand colors

blocks.text: Key idea: Hazard awareness is a skill you practice, not a fact you memorize.
